newsitem.title: USA: Tribune Co to sell Farm Journal Inc.
newsitem.headline: Tribune Co to sell Farm Journal Inc.

text.p: Tribune Co said Wednesday it would sell Farm Journal Inc, a publisher of five agricultural magazines, to a management group.
Farm Jounal president Roger Randall said the sale price was $17 million.
Philadelphia-based Farm Journal is a 120-year old publisher, which also has business interests in database management services and market research.
Its flagship publication is Farm Journal, with 650,000 circulation, Randall said.
Stanford Erickson, who had been publisher and president of Journal of Commerce Inc, has been named chairman of the board and chief executive officer, Randall said in an interview.
The Journal of Commerce is owned by the London-based The Economist Group.
Tribune Co had bought Farm Journal in 1994 for $17.5 million, Randall said.

"While Tribune Co provided us with expertise and investment capital to upgrade operations and set the foundation for communicating with farmers into the next century, returning to private ownership will provide further enhancements for business partnering and marketplace focus," Randall said in a news release.
Tribune shares were up 5/8 at 41-1/4 Wednesday.
